statement: GlobalWafers signed a 10-year long-term supply agreement with Micron starting in 2027 that includes upfront strategic financial support from Micron, described as among the wafer industry's longest-duration agreements.
why: A memory maker paying up front to lock in a decade of wafers is behaving like a buyer that expects scarcity, which is itself a tightness signal.

impact.mechanism: Long-term prepaid capacity reservations secure substrate for one buyer while removing it from the open market, tightening what remains available to everyone else.

evidence.excerpt: GlobalWafers signed a 10-year long-term agreement (LTA) with Micron, beginning next year (2027), including upfront strategic financial support from Micron -- described as one of the wafer industry's longest-duration agreements historically.
both memory and logic manufacturers are locking in long-term 300mm capacity

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the underlying agreement was announced separately in July 2026 and this is follow-up earnings-call commentary.
